content: Tesseract.js remains the standard fully-local/offline browser OCR choice for clean printed text, but is noticeably weaker than modern engines on noisy scans, complex layouts, tables, and handwriting. PaddleOCR (Baidu, PP-OCRv4) is a stronger open alternative with mobile/edge and server model variants, generally outperforming Tesseract on invoices and mixed-language documents, but has no mature browser/WASM/npm story comparable to Tesseract.js. For a personal local-first Lens-style tool prioritizing zero network dependency and simple JS integration, Tesseract.js remains the pragmatic pick; cloud OCR APIs (Google Vision, Azure Document Intelligence) offer materially higher accuracy but break the local-only/no-cloud-dependency constraint.
